text:
Morgan: Quick design review — the new sparkline granularity toggle in the Dashboard feels ambiguous. Users expect it to change resolution but the label says 'smooth'. :thinking:
Zach: +1. I clicked it thinking it would apply smoothing, but it actually changes bin size. Maybe the term 'granularity' or 'resolution' is clearer. :eyes:
Anu: Can we separate the controls? One toggle for smoothing (visual) and a dropdown for sampling/window size (data granularity). Two small affordances side-by-side?
Rachel: Agreed. Also accessibility nit: when focus lands on the sparkline widget the tooltip that appears is 1) truncated, 2) not announced by screen readers. We should ensure aria-live for the selected value. :a11y:
DesignBot: Accessibility checklist: ensure keyboard focusable, add aria-label to the toggle, announce tooltip via aria-live, and increase hit target to 32px.
Morgan: Proposed microcopy: dropdown label "Resolution" with options: "Auto", "1m", "5m", "1h". Smoothing control label: "Curve (visual)" with tooltip: "Smooths line for visual clarity; does not affect raw data bins."
Zach: Love the copy. For the small dropdown items can we use non-breaking spaces for units so they don't wrap?
Anu: Example tooltip text to include in UI copy: "Resolution controls sampling interval used to aggregate points for sparklines. Choose a finer interval to show spikes; coarser for trends."
Rachel: UX note: When switching resolution, add a subtle loader to indicate data re-aggregation; otherwise users think the toggle did nothing. 200ms fade-in should suffice.
Dan: Implementation note: backend supports three precomputed rollups: 1m, 5m, 1h. Falling back to 'Auto' should pick based on timespan. I'll add a routing policy.
Morgan: Visual suggestion: show small caption under the sparkline with current resolution and a clickable "Change" affordance for mobile. Copy: "Showing: 1m (Change)"
Zach: CSS snippet for compact caption: 
```
.spark-caption { font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); display:flex; gap:8px; align-items:center; }
.spark-caption a { color: var(--interactive); text-decoration: none; }
```
Anu: Accessibility checklist addition: ensure caption is programmatically associated with chart via aria-describedby.
Rachel: Decision? Split controls + update copy + loader + accessibility fixes. If we agree I'll mock up the separation and microcopy in Figma. :+1:
Morgan: Agreed. Action items: @Dan to add rollup flags + API param; @Rachel to update mock; @Anu to add a11y tickets; @Zach to review microcopy. I'll file follow-ups.
DesignBot: Created tasks: DESIGN-1023 (mock sparkline controls), ENG-5120 (rollups + resolution param), A11Y-221 (aria/live & captions).
